name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC alert warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine found as of 22 Nov
state: An IPC alert in October warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan as drought compounds the war, with child acute malnutrition above the famine threshold in two South Darfur camps (IRC, 13 Oct). WFP said on 19 Oct that funding cuts had forced it to halve rations in Gaza. These are risk warnings rather than a new Famine classification; searches on 22 Nov found none, so Watch holds.
for_you: No direct effect for most UK readers. Hunger in Sudan and Gaza drives displacement and aid appeals; UN agencies and the IPC publish the official assessments.
rubric_hit: IPC risk-of-famine alert for Darfur and Kordofan = Watch; no new Phase 5 confirmed

sources.title: IRC — War and El Niño-driven drought deplete food stocks, pushing Sudan further towards famine
WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce lifesaving assistance in Gaza

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
